The issuer shows solid profitability (EBIT of 8,386M on revenue 17,601M, ~48% margin) and adequate near-term liquidity (current ratio 1.55). However, leverage is high with total liabilities of 91,085M versus total assets of 114,935M, which meaningfully constrains financial flexibility. Overall, this supports a speculative-grade credit profile rather than investment grade.  
DECISION: BB-
